entry.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
entry.summary: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

entry.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
entry.summary: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.

entry.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
entry.summary: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

entry.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
entry.summary: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

entry.title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
entry.summary: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.

entry.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
entry.summary: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.

entry.title: Apple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and more, hit by outage
entry.summary: Apple's status page confirms its services are facing outages, but has not confirmed the cause.

entry.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
entry.summary: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.

entry.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
entry.summary: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

entry.title: Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order
entry.summary: The DMV said Waymo's freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety. Restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken "effective corrective actions" to address the deficiencies.

entry.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
entry.summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

entry.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
entry.summary: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

entry.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
entry.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

entry.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
entry.summary: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.

entry.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
entry.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

entry.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
entry.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?

entry.title: Stripe backer Atomico calls for Europe to own its success stories
entry.summary: Europe is home to many of the world's fastest growing companies of all time, veteran VC firm Atomico highlighted in its latest annual State of European Tech report.

entry.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
entry.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

entry.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
entry.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

entry.title: China dominates battery graphite, but this startup could break the monopoly
entry.summary: Chinese companies maintain near total dominance of the graphite industry, but Molten Industries says its new factory in Oakland could spell the end of the monopoly.
